$comment: The specanchor artefact schemas Goldpath authoring writes against (goldpath-authoring RFC V1; delivery-cycle D6). The three files beside this one are BYTE COPIES of the upstream files at `ref` and are never edited here: a change arrives by re-pinning. scripts/specanchor-freshness.sh proves the bytes still match this record (offline), still match upstream at `ref`, and that upstream has not moved ahead of the pin. specanchor had published no release or tag on the pin date, so `ref` is an immutable commit of its default branch; the gate turns red the day a tag exists, so the pin moves to it.
